headline: Keep editor changes recoverable
intro: Editor drafts keeps unsaved automation, script, and scene edits in a temporary Git repository so editors can offer them again after a crash or restart.
highlights: Autosaves preserve successive draft states as commits, with a history of up to 100 versions available to inspect or restore.
Draft data stays under .cache/editor_drafts, a location Home Assistant does not load as configuration; live items change only when the owner saves.
Drafts are removed when saved or discarded, and drafts untouched for 30 days are purged; Git must be installed for drafts to be kept.

flow.title: From edit to recovery
stages: The editor sends updated automation, script, or scene state.
Editor drafts records changed states in its temporary Git repository.
After a crash or restart, the editor can offer the draft again.
Saving or discarding removes the draft.
